title: Page 7
content_zh:
一直低着头的温宁怔住，继而诧异地抬起头，她惊讶得忘了要调整表情，眼眸中还有水气荡漾，眼泪要落不落的，格外令人心疼。
肖崇源垂眸，“为什么你不肯……再多忍耐一下？”为什么一定要决绝地离开他？温宁呆呆地看着他，“你……”
肖崇源回过神，这才察觉到自己刚刚的失态，他掩饰般笑了笑，将鸡蛋外面的卫生纸撕掉，然后把鸡蛋递给她，“吃掉。”
温宁迷茫的目光又看向那颗白白嫩嫩的鸡蛋，“什么？”
肖崇源把鸡蛋贴到她嘴上，看她傻傻地拿过鸡蛋后又重复了一遍，“让你吃掉。”
“可是这都滚过脸了。”温宁终于明白过来。
“不是裹着卫生纸了吗，不要浪费。”
“咕，还是那么枢。”温宁不着痕迹地抹了抹眼睛，小声地咕哝。
但温宁仍乖乖地开始吃鸡蛋，一面吃一面斜着眼睛，看肖崇源又捞起另外一颗开始拨壳，他那双灵活操作手术刀的手做其他事还真是废柴，剥个鸡蛋都慢吞吞的。
温宁咀嚼着鸡蛋，含糊着问：“其实你今天不用对蒙娜那么凶，不要因为我……影响你们的关系。”
“我们的关系？”
“嗯。”
“我和那种女人会有什么关系？”
“你们不是很亲近吗？”温宁的语气有点古怪。
“哦，我知道了。”肖崇源想了一下恍然大悟，无声地笑了笑，“你搬家那天，我没有和她在一起，而是和余放在休息室喝咖啡，之后我也没私下见过她。”
“为什么骗我？”
“有意思啊。”肖崇源大言不惭地说。
好恶劣！
“不要再想那种女人了。”肖崇源说。
“其实就算你们要交往，我不会也没资格介意，蒙娜那么漂亮，你要是喜欢也……”

“喜欢她？”肖崇源轻笑了几声，“我喜欢哪种女人，你是清楚的。”
“虽然你原本喜欢温顺寡言的，但你之前也说了，人总是会变的。”
“温顺寡言……”肖崇源看着温宁呢喃了一句，若有所思地点头，“是啊，会变的。”之前他那么讨厌温宁，可现在不也有所变化吗？
肖崇源用卫生纸裹住第二颗鸡蛋，伸手递给温宁，忽又想起一事，“对了，昨天晚上……”
温宁倏地僵住，她怎么把这事给忘了？在肖崇源继续开口之前，她抢先一步说：“昨晚你喝醉了，不知道自己酒量不好吗？还偏偏喝那么多，幸亏这次的红酒没有问题，要是又过敏了怎么办？”她嘀嘀咕咕数落了他一顿。
“我今天是在你房间醒来的。”
“是啊，昨晚你醉得走错房间，我就把房间让给你睡了。”温宁心虚地说，目光闪烁了一会后，又理直气壮地指了指沙发，“你早上没看到沙发上的枕头、被子吗？我昨晚就睡在这里，因为不习惯，早上起来还腰酸背痛呢。”
腰酸背痛当然不是因为这个啦……
肖崇源了解地点了点头，“哦，原来是这样啊。”
温宁重重地点头，自己接过鸡蛋，在脸颊上迅速地滚来滚去。
肖崇源没再说话，而是神情莫测地看着她，温宁头也不敢抬，静默了好一阵子之后，清了清嗓子说：“时、时间也不早了，我去准备午饭了。”说完就滚着鸡蛋朝厨房走去。
“别准备了。”肖崇源拦下她，“昨晚这么累，今天又发生了这么多事，你去房间休息吧，我们叫外送。”
昨晚这么累……他的话让温宁的背影一僵。
肖崇源却就此打住，伸了个懒腰也跟着站起来，“哎，我昨天也没睡好，现在去补眠。”说着就走进了卧室，丢下温宁一脸震惊地站在原地。
他他他他……他都知道？
几天之后，蒙娜打温宁巴掌的影片就曝光在网路上。
影片一上传就点击破万，即使蒙娜以前不算太红，现在也算是窜红了。
一直以来都以青春可爱形象示人的模特儿新秀蒙娜，在影片中打无辜的助理巴掌，行
事张狂，那副嘴脸令每个人看了都不禁心生厌恶，于是影片下面的恶意评论也日益增多。
而这时候，签了蒙娜作为形象代言人的B&W整形医院，也以形象不佳为由要求终止合约，而且违约金一毛钱都不付。

这件事在公司里闹得沸沸扬扬，温宁回家后也忍不住询问：“你这样子不是违约吗？会不会赔很多钱啊？”
“你在为你的公司争取利益？”肖崇源笑问。
“你知道我不是这个意思啦。”
“嗯，放心吧，我一分钱都不会掏，赔钱的应该是他们才对。”
“让我们公司赔钱？”温宁疑惑地眨眼。
“是蒙娜先传出了丑闻，有损医院形象，幸好海报还没有张贴出去，否则医院一切损失都该由经纪公司赔偿。”
肖崇源随口说了几句，接着又笑了笑，“说多了你也不明白，总之放心就是了，想让我掏钱哪有那么容易。”
这她当然知道了，肖崇源可是枢得要命，自然有的是办法不赔钱。
温宁松了口气，心里想着因为蒙娜的事，公司肯定会元气大伤。
温宁思忖了一下，看了看肖崇源的脸色，小心地说：“既然海报还没有贴出，医院的损失也不大，不如让他们少赔一点？”
“还说不是在替他们争取利益。”
“毕竟是我的饭碗嘛，如果公司赔到破产，我也就失业了。”
“我觉得很奇怪，他们都欺负你，你却还替他们着想。”肖崇源略有停顿，说出一句令人意外的话，“要是单纯是为了工作，我也可以帮你。”
温宁看了他几眼，笑了笑，“工作虽然重要，但人也要讲义气嘛，在我刚刚离家出走的时候，是公司收留了我，所以现在公司遇到困难，我总不好袖手旁观。”
“你不旁观又能怎样，你能改变什么？”
温宁语塞，讪讪地垂头，不高兴地说：“说得也是……我自不量力了。”
第8章(2)
肖崇源怎么会听她的呢，她现在不过是个帮佣。
见温宁垂头丧气的样子，肖崇源忍不住笑出了声，“开个玩笑而已，看你的小脸垮成那样。”
肖崇源笑咪咪地伸出两只手扯着温宁的脸蛋，语气夸张地说：“哟，好丑哦。”他像哄小孩一样逗弄着她，看她被自己逗得就要恼羞成怒的样子，顿时觉得心情大好。

“不要弄了嘛”
“我偏要弄。”
“痛啦！”温宁去拍他的手。
“胡说，癖青早就好了。”
两人你来我往的逗弄，逗着逗着就滚上了床。
温宁是为了公司的事来肖崇源的房间询问的，怎么到最后又滚上床了？
温宁被他捏得发痛又抓得发痒，一直在他身下滚来滚去，最后演变成咯咯笑了起来，她越尖叫，肖崇源下手就越重。
温宁忍不住求饶，“我认输啦，不要弄了……哈哈哈，好痒哦，放过我啦，不、不行了……”
“好。”温宁鬼使神差地答应了。
“乖。”肖崇源重新吻住她的唇，吮吸的力道是前所未有的温柔。
温宁起初还有些挣扎，但渐渐就酥软在他的抚摸之下。
虽然结婚时他们也并非只是公事公办，肖崇源总会顾及她的感受，但那仍旧与这一次不同。
温宁所有的感官神经都被他勾动起来，她能清晰地感觉到肖崇源滚烫的手指在自己的身体上游移，好像一条灵巧的鱼，淘气地钻到她的身体里，引起一波又一波的快/感，让她招架不住，只能窝在他的怀中阵阵娇喘。
content_en:
Wen Ning, who had been lowering her head, was stunned, and then raised her head in surprise. She was so surprised that she forgot to adjust her expression. There was still moisture in her eyes, and she couldn't help but shed tears, which was particularly distressing.
Xiao Chongyuan lowered his eyes, "Why don't you... endure it a little longer?" Why must you leave him decisively? Wen Ning looked at him blankly, "You..."
Xiao Chongyuan came to his senses and realized that he had just lost his composure. He smiled covertly, tore off the toilet paper from the outside of the egg, and then handed the egg to her, "Eat it."
Wen Ning's confused eyes looked at the white and tender egg again, "What?"
Xiao Chongyuan put the egg on her mouth. After watching her stupidly take the egg, he repeated, "Let you eat it."
"But this is all over the place." Wen Ning finally understood.
"Isn't it wrapped in toilet paper? Don't waste it."
"Gu, it's still so tight." Wen Ning wiped his eyes lightly and muttered softly.
But Wen Ning still obediently began to eat the eggs. As he ate, he squinted his eyes and watched Xiao Chongyuan pick up another one and start to peel the shell. His hands that flexibly manipulated the scalpel were useless at other things, even peeling an egg was slow.
Wen Ning chewed the egg and asked vaguely: "Actually, you don't have to be so cruel to Mona today. Don't let me... affect your relationship."
"Our relationship?"
"Yeah."
"What would I have to do with a woman like that?"
"Aren't you very close?" Wen Ning's tone was a little strange.
"Oh, I know." Xiao Chongyuan thought for a while and suddenly realized it, and smiled silently, "On the day you moved, I was not with her. Instead, I drank coffee with Yu in the lounge, and I didn't see her in private after that."
"Why did you lie to me?"
"It's interesting." Xiao Chongyuan said confidently.
How bad!
"Don't think about that kind of woman anymore." Xiao Chongyuan said.
"Actually, even if you want to date, I won't and have no right to mind. Mona is so beautiful. If you like it..."
"Like her?" Xiao Chongyuan chuckled a few times, "You know what kind of woman I like."
"Although you originally like to be meek and taciturn, you also said before that people will always change."
"Meek and taciturn..." Xiao Chongyuan looked at Wen Ning and murmured, nodding thoughtfully, "Yes, it will change." He hated Wen Ning so much before, but hasn't it changed now?
Xiao Chongyuan wrapped the second egg in toilet paper and handed it to Wen Ning. Suddenly he remembered something, "By the way, last night..."
Wen Ning froze suddenly. How could she forget this? Before Xiao Chongyuan continued to speak, she said first: "You were drunk last night. Don't you know that you have a bad ability to drink? You still drank so much. Fortunately, the red wine this time was fine. What if you are allergic again?" She muttered and scolded him.
"I woke up in your room today."
"Yes, you were so drunk that you went to the wrong room last night, so I let you sleep in the room." Wen Ning said guiltily. After his eyes flickered for a while, he pointed to the sofa confidently, "Didn't you see the pillows and quilts on the sofa this morning? I slept here last night. Because I'm not used to it, I still have back pain when I wake up in the morning."
Of course the soreness and back pain is not due to this...
Xiao Chongyuan nodded in understanding, "Oh, so that's it."
Wen Ning nodded heavily, took the egg himself, and rolled it quickly on his cheek.
Xiao Chongyuan didn't speak anymore, but looked at her with an unpredictable expression. Wen Ning didn't dare to raise his head. After being silent for a while, he cleared his throat and said, "It's getting late. I'm going to prepare lunch." After that, he rolled the eggs and walked towards the kitchen.
"Stop getting ready." Xiao Chongyuan stopped her, "I was so tired last night and so many things happened today. You can go to your room and rest. We will order delivery."
So tired last night...heWen Ning's back froze at his words.
Xiao Chongyuan stopped there, stretched and stood up, "Hey, I didn't sleep well yesterday, so I'm going to catch up on my sleep now." After saying that, he walked into the bedroom, leaving Wen Ning standing there with a shocked look on his face.
He, he, he... he knows?
A few days later, the video of Mona slapping Wen Ning was exposed on the Internet.
As soon as the video was uploaded, it received over 10,000 views. Even though Mona was not very popular before, she is still very famous now.
Mona, a new model who has always shown a youthful and cute image, slapped an innocent assistant in the video.
It was so arrogant, and his face made everyone feel disgusted after watching it, so the number of malicious comments on the video also increased day by day.
At this time, B&W Plastic Surgery Hospital, which signed Mona as its image spokesperson, also requested to terminate the contract due to poor image, and did not pay a cent as liquidated damages.
This incident caused quite a stir in the company. After Wen Ning returned home, he couldn't help but ask, "Isn't this a breach of contract? Will you lose a lot of money?"
"Are you fighting for the interests of your company?" Xiao Chongyuan asked with a smile.
"You know that's not what I meant."
"Well, don't worry, I won't pay a penny. They should be the ones to pay."
"Let our company lose money?" Wen Ning blinked in confusion.
"It was Mona who spread the scandal first, which damaged the image of the hospital. Fortunately, the posters have not been posted yet. Otherwise, all losses to the hospital should be compensated by the brokerage company."
Xiao Chongyuan said a few words casually, and then smiled, "You won't understand even if you talk too much, so just don't worry. It's not that easy to ask me to pay."
Of course she knew this. Xiao Chongyuan was very smart, so naturally he had many ways not to lose money.
Wen Ning breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that because of Mona's incident, the company's vitality would definitely be severely damaged.
Wen Ning thought for a moment, looked at Xiao Chongyuan's face, and said carefully: "Since the poster hasn't been posted yet, the hospital's losses are not big, why not let them pay less?"
"He also said that he was not fighting for their interests."
"After all, it is my job. If the company goes bankrupt, I will be unemployed."
"I find it strange that they bully you but you still think about them." Xiao Chongyuan paused briefly and said something surprising, "If it's just for work, I can help you."
Wen Ning glanced at him and smiled, "Although work is important, people must also be loyal. When I just ran away from home, the company took me in, so now that the company is encountering difficulties, I can't just sit back and watch."
"So what if you don't watch? What can you change?"
Wen Ning was speechless, lowered his head, and said unhappily: "That's right...I overestimated my ability."
Chapter 8(2)
How could Xiao Chongyuan listen to her? She is just a helper now.
Seeing Wen Ning's dejected look, Xiao Chongyuan couldn't help laughing, "It was just a joke, look at your little face falling like that."
Xiao Chongyuan smiled and stretched out his hands to pull Wen Ning's face, and said in an exaggerated tone: "Oh, so ugly." He teased her like a child, and seeing how angry she was when he teased her, he suddenly felt very good.
"Don't do it"
"I insist on doing it."
"It hurts!" Wen Ning patted his hand.
"Nonsense, Qingqing has been cured long ago."
The two of them teased each other back and forth, and rolled into bed while teasing.
Wen Ning came to Xiao Chongyuan's room to inquire about the company, so how come he ended up in bed again?
Wen Ning was pinched and scratched until it hurt, and she kept rolling around under him, which finally turned into giggling. The more she screamed, the harder Xiao Chongyuan hit her.
Wen Ning couldn't help but beg for mercy, "I give up, don't do it anymore... Hahaha, it's so itchy, please let me go, no, I can't do it anymore..."
"Okay." Wen Ning made a mistakeAgree.
"Be good." Xiao Chongyuan kissed her lips again, his sucking force was unprecedentedly gentle.
Wen Ning struggled a little at first, but gradually softened under his touch.
Although they were not just doing business when they got married, Xiao Chongyuan would always take her feelings into consideration, but it was still different from this time.
All of Wen Ning's sensory nerves were aroused by him. She could clearly feel Xiao Chongyuan's hot fingers moving on her body, like a nimble fish, naughtily burrowing into her body, causing waves of pleasure. She couldn't resist it and could only lie in his arms and gasp.
